topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I keep pacing by the window, watching the vase on the table. The flowers are beautiful, really, an array of pastel tones that seem to soften the room. But the absence of a card... it makes me fidget with the hem of my shirt. I ought to have foreseen this, considered more, ensured every detail was perfect. Now, I can only hope that the gesture speaks louder than the silence. I should go and check if she's found them yet, maybe drop by casually, offer to water them. It's a start, at least, a way to bridge the gap that my oversight has created.
